purpose: Second-hazard held-out evaluation using temperature-extreme geographic footprints.
candidate_forecast_inputs: GEFSv12 2m temperature ensemble as transparent substitute

target_definition.primary: location- and season-aware upper-tail temperature anomaly footprint
target_definition.note: Official IMD heat-wave warning criteria are not approximated unless the required station/regional criteria are implemented exactly.

rules: Select train/validation/test dates before viewing test skill.
No threshold tuning on the held-out event.
Do not claim cyclone-trained weights transfer to temperature hazards without retraining/evaluation.
Software hazard-generic evaluation is not multi-hazard scientific validation.
blocked_by: No frozen held-out heat-wave forecast/reference dataset is bundled in v1.4.
